shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ---; ls -la /home/sandbox/workspace; echo ---; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; sed -n 1,40p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ---; grep -n -i -C 3 'toast' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40; echo ---; ls src; echo ---; for f in src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo ---; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button 2>&1 | head -80; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/; echo ---; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -iname 'README*' -path '*Toaster*'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster 2>&1 | head -60; echo "--- types.d.ts"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; echo "--- index.d.ts"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; echo "--- Toaster.d.ts"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts; echo "--- constants"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/constants.d.ts; echo "--- Provider"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/*.d.ts; echo "--- ToasterComponent"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/*.d.ts; echo "--- hooks"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/*.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; grep -n -i -C 2 'toast' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -30; echo "--- autoHiding defaults"; grep -rn -C 2 'autoHiding\|DEFAULT_TIMEOUT\|TIMEOUT' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/constants.js | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; grep -o '\.g-toaster{[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.css 2>/dev/null || grep -rho '\.g-toaster{[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ | head -2; cat .gitignore; git status --short

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; f=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster -name '*.css' | head -5); echo "$f"; grep -ho 'g-toaster[^{]*{[^}]*position[^}]*}' $f | head -3; rm -rf dist; git status --short
